document: Morocco, Decree 2-14-499, Bulletin Officiel 6306, 6 November 2014, fire-safety annex
scope: Author-labelled hypothetical ground-floor public establishments, 35 occupants each, no declared exceptions. Both plans have a main circulation, a public room on a dead end, a protected stair, a two-way escape corridor with a subdivision door, door glazing, and a public egress door. This fixture starts at the plan-fact boundary.

A.description: Two eligible exits including one accessory and an extra candidate that is not a distinct exit. Both qualifying exits are available to the room. Travel 32 m; dead end 8 m; connector 1.50 m; stair discharge 12 m; one-UP door clear width 0.91 m. No isolated steps. Partitions and smoke protection satisfy the clause. Subdivision door swings both ways. Glazing clear and neutral. A manual sliding door closes one public exit. Finishes conform. Interior release easy.

B.description: One eligible normal exit; the apparent second exit is a fixed panel. Travel 34 m; dead end 12 m; connector 1.25 m; stair discharge 22 m; one-UP door clear width 0.80 m. Two isolated steps. Partition fire rating is insufficient; smoke protection conforms. Subdivision door swings one way. Glazing transparent red. A manual sliding door closes the public exit. Ceiling finish fails; wall and floor finishes conform. Interior release requires a key.

clauses.meaning: At least two eligible ways out. The table separately requires one normal 1-UP exit and one accessory exit.
One normal 1-UP way out and one accessory way out; clear width is assessed under the door clause.
Maximum travel is 50 m with two available exits, or 30 m with one. These plans have one relevant origin and all eligible exits are accessible from it.
Walk from the public-room door to the dead-end junction at most 10 m.
The horizontal connector between a stair and exit must offer at least two passage units, 1.40 m.
Protected stair leads directly outdoors or discharges at most 20 m from an exit.
Clear passage for the designated one-UP door must be at least 0.855 m after the permitted 5% below 0.90 m.
Subdivision doors in the horizontal circulation used in both directions toward exits must swing both ways.
No isolated group of one or two steps in the principal circulation.
Horizontal circulation enclosure fire rating meets the rating required for the structure.
Horizontal circulation provides prescribed smoke protection under the general provision.
Door glazing is transparent and is neither red nor orange.
A nonmotorized sliding door cannot close a public evacuation exit.
Horizontal circulation ceiling finish meets M1.
Circulation partition and floor finish meet M2 and M4 respectively.
With the public present, the exit opens from inside by pushing or by easy use of one device per leaf.
